COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No. 1533 of 2024
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J
1. Mr. Shailendra Nauriyal, learned counsel 
for the petitioners.
2. Mr. Nagesh Agarwal, learned counsel for 
the respondents.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits 
that respondent nos. 7 & 12 have passed away 
on 01.11.2024 and August, 2024, respectively; 
since their legal representatives are already on 
record, therefore, against their names, 
expression “deceased” has to be mentioned. 
Prayer to this effect has been made in the 
application (IA No. 5 of 2025) filed by the 
petitioner. 
4. Mr. Nagesh Agarwal, learned counsel for 
the respondent submits that he has no
objection to the prayer made by petitioner in 
the application.
5. For the reasons indicated in the 
application, the miscellaneous application (IA 
No. 5 of 2025) is allowed.
6. Learned counsel for the petitioner shall 
file amended memo of parties within a week.
7. List this case on 22.08.2025.
8. In the meantime, petitioner may file 
rejoinder affidavit, if any. It is made clear that 
no further adjournment shall be given to the 
parties on the next date fixed.
 (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J)
 17.07.2025
Aswal
